categories.main_business_segments: Comba Telecom operates primarily in two segments: wireless telecommunications network system equipment and services, and operator telecommunication services. The company manufactures and sells base station antennas and subsystems, network products including indoor coverage solutions, wireless transmission equipment, and provides related engineering and installation services. It also operates a telecom operator business through its subsidiary ETL in Laos.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced R&D in wireless communication technologies, including multi-frequency and multi-system convergent antennas, green antenna solutions with enhanced energy efficiency, and 5G-A technology for low-altitude network coverage. Manufacturing is centralized in Guangzhou with advanced production capabilities. The company emphasizes innovation in antenna design, network system solutions, and integration of AI, IoT, and 5G technologies, including cellular passive IoT systems and relay networking solutions.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major Chinese telecom operators such as China Mobile, China Unicom, China Telecom, and China Tower, as well as international mobile operators and core equipment manufacturers. The company serves telecommunications network operators, integrators, and industries requiring indoor and outdoor wireless coverage solutions globally.
categories.geographic_coverage: Comba Telecom has a strong presence in Mainland China with over 30 offices, and more than 20 overseas offices covering over 100 countries and regions. Major markets include China, Asia Pacific, Americas, Europe, and the Middle East. It also operates telecom services in Laos through its subsidiary ETL.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the wireless telecommunications supply chain, focusing on R&D, manufacturing, and sales of network equipment and solutions, as well as providing operator telecommunication services. It supplies equipment to telecom operators and integrators for network construction and enhancement.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing 5G and 5G-A technologies, green and energy-efficient antenna solutions, Open RAN development, and expanding applications in vertical industries such as smart mining, warehousing, and transport. The company invests heavily in R&D to maintain technological leadership, focusing on multi-technology integration, AI, IoT, and intelligent network solutions to meet evolving market demands.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through the manufacture and sale of wireless telecommunications network system equipment and provision of related installation and engineering services. Additionally, revenue comes from operator telecommunication services via its subsidiary ETL. The company also earns from after-sales services and technical support.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Comba Telecom is a globally recognized leader in wireless communication solutions, ranking top in the global DAS vendor list and holding a leading position in base station antenna manufacturing. It competes with other telecom equipment manufacturers and network solution providers, leveraging its strong R&D, patent portfolio, and comprehensive service network to maintain competitive advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of HK$4.53 billion, a 24.3% decrease from 2023, with a gross profit margin of 25.9%. It experienced a net loss attributable to owners of HK$564 million due to market challenges and project slowdowns. Total assets stood at HK$7.44 billion with a stable gearing ratio of 11.3%. The company maintains a sound financial position with sufficient working capital despite recent revenue declines.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Comba Telecom emphasizes advanced technology, reliable quality, and environmentally friendly, energy-efficient products. Its green antenna solutions and innovative 5G-A technologies provide customers with cost-effective, high-performance wireless coverage, including unique low-altitude network solutions. The company’s comprehensive product portfolio and global service network enable tailored solutions that meet diverse operator and industry needs.
